seriesTitle: The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin

episodes.title: Island of the Mighty
episodes.summary: The age of gods is dying & the Tribes of Britain descend into chaos.  One man hears a voice that will change history.

episodes.title: The Vision of Taliesin
episodes.summary: A forbidden union gives birth to a prophecy that will outlive the world that made it.

episodes.title: A Fatherless Child
episodes.summary: Alone for years in the wild, Marlin returns a changed man - Hardened by trial tempered by faith, and carrying the weight of visions yet to come. As Vortigern's fragile alliance crumbles and Saecsen power surges, Merlin must choose when - and how to shape the fate of Britain.

episodes.title: The King Maridunum
episodes.summary: As Britain bleeds, Merlin must forge unity from chaos-while darkness moves behind kings and blades.

episodes.title: The Price of Failure
episodes.summary: War brews, loyalties splinter, and Merlin's past erupts—threatening to destroy the fragile future he fights for.

episodes.title: Ganieda
episodes.summary: After years in exile, Merlin returns to a divided kingdom and meets the woman who will test his destiny.

episodes.title: The Last True Bard
episodes.summary: Britain gathers for war. Merlin rises from shadow to crown the one king who can unite them all.
